steps.title: Start a new round
steps.text: Return the ball and compare the scores. This is a generated game round, not an analysis of a photon stream. Press Restart when you are ready to replace the current round.

await.hint: Press Restart in the game header.

steps.title: Read the controls
steps.text: Up/Down moves your paddle; M changes the opponent mode and W/S controls the second player. P pauses. Open Help for the complete controls and sound behavior.

await.hint: Press Help in the game header.

steps.title: Check the fresh round
steps.text: Close Help, then press Restart once more. Check that both scores have reset and a fresh serve begins. The guide waits for your click; it never presses a control for you.

await.hint: Press Restart in the game header and inspect the reset round.
